This bounded surge replaces vague doubling of every aura number. At 20 Divine Manifestation makes the aura active upon initiative without an action, radius 30 ft; it ignores ordinary Silence and terrain obstruction between allies but not antimagic explicitly suppressing divine powers, planar barriers or the consciousness rule. Source cannot-be-suppressed language is bounded explicitly. It grants no free Signature, Smite or Revelation spell.

card.name: Divine Strike
card.effect: Use engine Divine Strike/Smite dice and later Oath modification. Declare after hit, then pay; normal critical dice rules. Not a spell and produces no Dissonance. Cannot trigger from reflected/copy/companion damage.

source.originalText: Divine Strike: Channel divine energy into your weapon attacks, dealing additional damage.

card.name: Bolstering Presence
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies 15 ft who can perceive you
card.effect: Each gains+2 on its next save against Charmed or Frightened and M temporary HP. Use strongest save bonus from same class; does not end existing conditions automatically.

source.originalText: Bolstering Presence: Inspire nearby allies, granting them temporary bonuses to saves against fear and charm effects.

card.name: Divine Sense
card.effect: Divine Sense identifies celestial/fiend/undead nature despite ordinary disguise or shapeshift. Still requires clear line of effect; cannot reveal through walls or defeat artifact-specific concealment without its rule.

source.originalText:
Divine Sense: Detect Disguised Outsiders (Level 18)
Your Divine Sense now reveals outsiders (celestials, fiends, etc.) even if they are disguised or shapeshifted.

card.name: Dread Shelter
card.effect: New rank 2 Forbidden spell. Gain 2 S+M temporary HP on casting and 1 flat DR against weapon damage for duration. No recurring temp HP pulse or healing.

card.name: Black Manifestation
card.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 3 enemies in aura
card.effect: New Oathbreaker Final: gain 2 S+M temporary HP; chosen enemies WIS save or lose Reactions and Speed-10 ft for duration. Refresh one expended Signature use, then pay its normal Action and other costs when used. No Death Touch pool, RP, extra Action or Final reset.

card.name: Channel Life
card.rangeAndTarget: Self and one living ally within 30 feet
card.effect: Choose X from 1 to Paladin level+M, limited so your current HP remains at least 1. Lose X HP; this loss cannot be reduced, redirected or prevented. The target regains X HP. This is a direct transfer, cannot exceed the target's maximum HP and cannot remove Wounds or create excess temporary HP.

value.spell: Channel Life — transfer HP from self to ally

card.name: Healing Suppression
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen creatures in your Oath aura
card.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
card.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
card.effect: HP healing received by each selected creature is halved, rounded down. Temporary HP, damage prevention and resurrection are not healing for this effect. This suppression cannot reduce healing below 0 or convert prevented healing into damage.

originalObjects.value: Healing Suppression — all healing within aura reduced by 50%

card.name: Verdict Absolute
card.rangeAndTarget: One Judgment Brand target; witnesses in your aura
card.effect: For 3 rounds, your current Judgment Brand cannot be removed by an ordinary save or concealment effect. Smites against the branded target use maximum Smite dice, and it cannot voluntarily teleport or become invisible. If the branded target reaches 0 HP during the effect, restore your Lay on Hands pool to its normal maximum once, then up to three hostile creatures in your aura that witnessed the defeat make Wisdom saves; on failure they are Frightened until the end of their next turn. The Lay on Hands refill requires a meaningful nonsummoned hostile defeated in a real encounter; staged or willing sacrifices do not qualify.

originalObjects.value: Verdict Absolute — once per day, your Judgment Brand cannot be resisted: marked foes suffer max-dice smites, cannot teleport or become invisible, and if reduced to 0 HP you restore your full Lay on Hands pool; unmarked foes who witness the execution must save or become frightened until end of next turn.

card.name: Primordial Surge
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen creatures in your Oath aura
card.duration: Temporary HP until lost; root until end of target's next turn
card.effect: A selected ally gains temporary HP equal to 2 times your actual Charisma modifier, minimum 2. A selected hostile fey or elemental makes a Strength save; on failure roots bind it and its Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn. This root does not remove Actions or Reactions. You may mix allied and hostile targets but can select no more than 3 total creatures.

value.spell: Primordial Surge — allies in aura gain temp HP equal to 2× CHA mod from land; fey/elementals in aura save or are rooted until end of next turn

card.name: Linked Ward
card.rangeAndTarget: One willing ally in your Oath aura
card.effect: Mark one willing ally. Once per round when it takes damage, use your Reaction to redirect up to 2 times your actual Charisma modifier, minimum 2, of that damage to yourself. Redirected damage keeps its type and cannot be redirected again. If this redirected damage reduces you to 0 HP, the ally gains temporary HP equal to the amount you actually absorbed, maximum Paladin level+M.

value.spell: Linked Ward — mark ally within aura; as reaction when they take damage, redirect up to 2× CHA mod radiant to yourself; if you fall to 0 HP this round, ally gains temp HP equal to damage redirected

card.name: Final Stand
card.rangeAndTarget: One willing ally in your Oath aura
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.effect: Until the start of your next turn, all damage that would be dealt to the chosen ally is redirected to you instead. The redirected damage retains type, cannot be redirected again and cannot be mitigated again after the original target’s defenses apply once. If redirected damage reduces you to 0 HP, the ally immediately gains temporary HP equal to your Paladin level and resistance to all damage until the end of its next turn. This effect ends if you die outright.

value.spell: Final Stand — for 1 round, absorb all damage dealt to one chosen ally in aura; if you fall to 0 HP from redirected damage, ally gains temp HP equal to your level and resistance to all damage until end of next turn

card.name: Unbroken Covenant
card.rangeAndTarget: Your full Oath aura; up to 3 bonded allies
card.effect: For 3 rounds Warden's Lock fills your entire current Oath aura. Choose up to 3 allies there as bonded. Each bonded ally uses your AC if it is higher and cannot be forcibly moved against its will. Whenever you redirect damage from a bonded ally to yourself, that ally gains temporary HP equal to half the actual damage you absorb, rounded down, maximum S+M per event. Temporary HP do not stack. This Final grants no extra Reactions.

originalObjects.value: Unbroken Covenant — once per day, Warden's Lock expands to your full aura radius for 3 rounds; bonded allies share your AC, cannot be moved against their will, and when you redirect damage to yourself they gain temp HP equal to half damage absorbed until the lock ends.

card.name: Echo of the Fallen
card.rangeAndTarget: One allied creature who died in your aura this encounter; one target within the former ally's normal weapon range or one ally in your aura
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At most once per fallen ally per long rest
card.effect: Manifest the ally's spirit for one round. Choose one mode on cast. Strike: the spirit makes one attack using the deceased ally's last recorded ordinary weapon attack bonus and base weapon damage, with no class-resource riders, extra attacks or proc effects. Guard: one chosen ally in your aura gains +2 AC until the start of your next turn. The spirit is not resurrected, cannot be targeted and disappears afterward. The single spirit strike uses PB+CHA to hit and S d8+M damage of the original weapon type if the recorded profile would exceed either value. It consumes the shared damaging-companion-action budget for that round; no monster or high-level player stat-block duplication.

value.spell: Echo of the Fallen — summon spirit of fallen ally within aura for 1 round; it makes one attack or grants chosen ally +2 AC as reaction

card.name: Dirge of Ruin
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 creatures in your Oath aura
card.duration: Damage instantaneous; healing block until end of next turn
card.effect: Each target makes a Constitution save, taking 2 S d6 necrotic damage on failure or half on success. A failing target cannot regain HP until the end of its next turn. This does not prevent temporary HP or remove healing already received.

originalObjects.value: Dirge of Ruin — necrotic wave that prevents healing

card.name: King's Smite
card.cost: Use normal Divine Smite cost: 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for (S+1)d8
card.rangeAndTarget: Creature hit by your melee weapon attack; one ally in your aura
card.duration: Smite instantaneous; temporary HP until lost; redirection passive while this Oath is active
card.frequency: One paid Smite total per round, shared with all normal and reactive Smite uses; any redirection uses its shared allowance
card.effect: The Smite deals radiant damage normally. After it resolves, choose one ally in your aura; it gains temporary HP equal to half the actual radiant Smite damage dealt, rounded down, maximum S+M. Separately, once per round when an ally in your aura takes damage, you may redirect up to 5 of that damage to yourself. Apply the original target’s defenses once, then transfer up to 5 of the remaining damage. Transferred damage keeps its type and cannot be reduced again, reflected, redirected again or generate resources.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 3; Oath of the Martyr King

originalObjects.value: Radiant — bonus damage; allies in aura gain temp HP when you smite; you may redirect 5 damage from one ally per round

conductClauses: Bear the responsibility of command without treating those in your care as a means to your glory
Set the realm's need above personal gain, and spend your own strength before you spend another's
Never demand a burden you would not freely take upon yourself

card.name: Noble Bearing
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to three allies in your aura
card.effect: Selected allies gain +1 on morale checks and saves against Frightened. Once on each of your turns after a paid Smite deals radiant damage, one selected ally gains temporary HP equal to half the actual Smite damage, rounded down, capped at S+M. This replaces, rather than stacks with, the identical King’s Smite temporary HP. Temporary HP never stack.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 3; Oath of the Martyr King

value.spell: Noble Bearing — allies within aura +1 to morale saves; when you smite, one chosen ally gains temp HP equal to half radiant dealt

card.name: Last King’s Gift
card.activation: Reaction before ally falls to 0 HP
card.rangeAndTarget: One living ally in your aura
card.duration: Instant prevention; temporary HP until lost or encounter end
card.effect: When damage would reduce the ally to 0 HP without killing it outright, it instead remains at 1 HP and gains temporary HP equal to your Paladin level after the triggering damage resolves. This does not reverse a completed death, remove Wounds or replenish any resource.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 17; Oath of the Martyr King

value.spell: Last King's Gift — when ally in aura would drop to 0 HP, they drop to 1 HP instead and gain temp HP equal to your level once per combat per ally

card.name: Crownshatter Decree Aura
card.path: Oathbreaker — Oath of the Martyr King
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to three selected enemies in your aura
card.effect: A selected enemy receives HP healing only if it has taken actual damage from a meaningful hostile creature since the start of its previous regular turn. If it has not, that healing restores 0 HP; its source still spends its normal costs. Temporary HP, stabilization and resurrection are not HP healing for this restriction. This aura never creates damage, transfers healing or reverses recovery that already resolved.
card.prerequisite: Paladin 3; Oathbreaker — Oath of the Martyr King

originalObjects.value: Crownshatter Decree — damage required for healing

card.displayPath: Usurper's Crown — Oath of the Martyr King Oathbreaker

classRecords.text: Weapon Synergy tracks last successful direct weapon hit on your own turns. Changing melee→ranged grants+1 to that ranged attack roll if it is your first attack of the turn; changing ranged→melee makes the hit apply Bleed 1d4 on target's next 2 turns. Once/turn synergy; Do Ts, copies, companions, forced attacks and misses do not advance it. At 5 ordinary Attack Action makes two attacks; techniques use only printed counts. You may draw/stow one weapon as normal object interaction; Dual Style later improves this.

Druidic Arrow Combo starts at Ranger 11, not at Base 1. Each direct successful weapon hit adds 1 Hit Chain, maximum 2 gained per regular turn and cap 3. Completing 3 primes one Arrow until end next turn; using it consumes the chain, even on miss. Efficient Killer lowers threshold 2. Chain starts/ends encounters 0, cannot be stocked against allies/captives/summons and is cleared by incapacitation. The Arrow is one Action with a ranged weapon attack or the stated save, costs 0 RP when primed, and is a magical class technique rather than an ordinary spell cast. At most one Arrow per round; it cannot advance its own chain. It requires a wielded bow and ammunition. Ordinary attack/damage riders apply once as printed, never another free arrow.

Chosen Hero grants a sixth Arrow at 11. Warder Nature's Wrath: ranged attack weapon+S d6 piercing; up to 2 allies within 10 ft gain M temporary HP (finite mitigation, not repeatable real healing). Stalker Phantom: two ranged attacks against different aligned targets within 60 ft, each weapon damage, no extra dice; one Arrow activation. Outrider Corruption: place 10 ft-radius zone within 60 ft, concentration until start next turn; up to 3 enemies entering/starting there take S d4 necrotic once each, CON half. Arrow copies cannot generate extra attacks, resources or permanent terrain changes.

Base choices 1–2, Pathfinder Arch 3–9, and chosen Warder/Stalker/Outrider Hero 10–20 are distinct stages. No source Arch capstone/Finale exists: level 9 receives its normal eligible choice, while 20 automatically improves your Hero Arrow once/long rest (new capstone below). Do not acquire a Hero by spending Base choices. Beast Companion is one permanent bond; it must be a willing/tamed noncorrupted beast with INT<7 and CR no greater than your class level. Its combat profile uses the bounded companion below rather than importing a full CR 20 monster.

card.name: Weapon Bond
card.rangeAndTarget: One bow or pair of blades touched
card.effect: Bond weapons. Bonus Action summons one bonded weapon to your hand from within 30 ft if not held by another creature and no total cover. Cannot disarm someone or cross planar boundaries; bond no additional items.

source.originalText: Weapon Bond: Form a special connection with either a bow or a pair of blades, allowing you to summon them to your hand.

card.name: Beast Empathy
card.rangeAndTarget: Natural beasts within 30 ft that hear you
card.effect: Communicate simple emotions/directions. They are not automatically friendly or controlled, cannot answer beyond their experience, and may need normal Animal Handling. No language-based compulsion or extra companion slot.

source.originalText: Beast Empathy: Communicate basic concepts with natural beasts.

card.name: Healing Touch
card.rangeAndTarget: One other ally healed by your paid spell/item
card.effect: Add M HP to actual healing. Do not multiply potion dice or duplicate consumed items; cannot apply to regeneration, companions' healing, copies or another Ranger's same bonus.

source.originalText: Healing Touch: Your healing spells and items are 25% more effective on allies.

card.name: Nature's Blessing
card.effect: Ally gains+10 ft Speed and S d6+M temporary HP on start. While effect lasts it has advantage on saves against forced movement. Temporary HP are not refreshed each turn.

source.originalText: Nature's Blessing: Grant an ally temporary bonuses to speed and resilience.

card.name: Beast Companion
card.cost: 4 RP; 1 hour with a willing/tamed eligible beast
card.effect: Bond eligible beast using standard companion stats plus Wisdom modifier HP; preserve one movement mode up to 40 ft and keen-sense advantage. Bonus Action command gives one attack, no imported boss powers. Injury persists; heal normally. Death requires a new bond after long rest, not free resummoning.

source.originalText: Beast Companion: Tame one beast from the bestiary (CR ≤ your level, INT < 7, not corrupted) as a permanent companion that scales with your Wisdom and level.

card.name: Predator's Grin
card.rangeAndTarget: Self after directly reducing quarry to 0
card.effect: Gain one extra full Action next turn within the shared cap. It cannot grant another Action or trigger another Predator's Grin. Allies, summons, helpless creatures and ongoing copied damage do not qualify.

source.originalText: Predator's Grin: Killing a tracked target grants you an extra action once per rest.

card.name: Master of the Hunt — new Hero capstone
card.effect: New playtest Hero capstone. Once per long rest when using your Hero Arrow, pay its normal Hit Chain/action requirements, then enhance only that activation: Warder grants 2 M temporary HP instead of M; Stalker adds S d6 piercing to one of its two hits; Outrider adds S d4 necrotic to one target on its single pulse. No extra Arrow, Hit Chain, action or copied proc.

classRecords.text: Wisdom is the class ability. Choose Elemental Affinity automatically at 1: Fire, Ice, Air or Earth. Spellcasting/RP remain separate from Totem objects and flasks. Totem capacity 1, rises 2 at 13; any third replaces one of your existing totems. A totem is a visible Tiny magical object: AC 12+PB, HP 2 L, immobile, immune to poison/psychic/conditions, vulnerable to ordinary weapon and other damage. At 0 HP its aura ends. A new totem appears within 30 ft; cannot occupy a creature's space, serve as a bridge, trap a creature without a save or move through walls.

Totem Casting is Action 2 RP, duration 3 of your turns, 15 ft aura. Choose Flame, Stone, Frost, Spirit or Renewal. Benefits require an ally/target in the aura, maximum 3 creatures benefiting per pulse/round chosen by you. Flame adds 1 fire to an ally's first direct weapon hit per round; on critical that target Burns 1d4 next turn. Stone reduces damage by 1 and gives enemies-1 to STR checks to shove. Frost: enemy first entering/starting each round makes CON save or Speed-10 ft until end its turn. Spirit: first necrotic/hex damage per target per round adds 1. Renewal: on start and each of next 2 turns with Bonus Action+1 RP maintenance, up to 3 allies regain 2 HP. Thus Renewal total cost 4 RP for 3 pulses; no free healing on entry. All totems share one concentration burden; losing it ends all. Other concentration effects replace them. Non-Renewal auras need no Bonus Action upkeep. Multiple same-name/stat auras do not stack.

On your turn you may spend Bonus Action to move one totem up to 15 ft along unobstructed ground, remaining within 60 ft. This competes with healing maintenance, companion commands and advanced flasks. Moving an aura over a creature cannot trigger its once/round effect repeatedly. Totem destruction creates no resource return. Once per round, the first ordinary spell cast while inside your own active totem aura generates 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0; no RP reduction.

Choose Fire/Ice/Air/Earth bonuses through affinity card; Ember/Cold/Shock damage are fire/cold/lightning, Earth uses bludgeoning. Summoned elemental spirits use one standard companion each, maximum one normally; Elemental Chorus expressly summons a package of 4 but all share one Bonus Action command and a printed combined pulse. Companions cannot generate RP, trigger flask refunds or create corpse/kill farms.

Bloodcaller at Hero 10 transforms permanently into Hagraven, with the player choosing this class path and its stated loss of ordinary Shaman spellcasting. It does NOT lose its RP reservoir: printed Hagraven/Totem techniques still pay RP, but it cannot cast ordinary Shaman spells or advanced magical flasks. It retains prior totem/technique selections. The change is a class choice, not permission for involuntary player-character conversion; ancestry identity and player control remain. At long rest it can prepare mundane flasks only if Base Flask Use is known.

card.name: Totem Casting
card.rangeAndTarget: One totem within 30 ft with 15 ft aura
card.effect: Place one Flame/Stone/Frost/Spirit/Renewal totem using the engine's exact profile. All your totems share concentration. Respect 3 creature aura/pulse limit; same-stat bonuses do not stack. Replacing a totem ends it without refund.

source.originalText: Totem Casting: Place a totem that creates an aura effect for 3 rounds.

card.name: Spirit Shock
card.effect: Target makes DEX save: S d8 affinity damage, half on success. Affinity rider applies once; this printed technique is not an ordinary spell, cannot Overcast and does not generate a flask or totem.

source.originalText: Spirit Shock: Channel elemental energy into a damaging burst.

card.name: Extended Totem Duration
card.cost: 0; full upkeep for extra Renewal pulse
card.effect: Totems last 1 extra turn. Renewal may have a fourth pulse only if you pay Bonus Action+1 RP on that turn; no fifth pulse and no automatic free healing. Concentration still required.

source.originalText: Extended Totem Duration: Totems last for an additional round.

card.name: Spirit Cache
card.rangeAndTarget: One flask/to-tem effect you directly used
card.effect: Store its profile, not an active copy. On a later turn use normal Action/Bonus Action and pay all RP and a new flask unit or full totem cost to repeat it. Add 1d6 to one numerical damage/heal amount; no copy of refund/limited use.

source.originalText: Spirit Cache: Store one flask or totem effect to recast later (once per encounter).

card.name: Totem Pulse
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 creatures inside newly placed non-healing totem
card.effect: On placement pay 1 RP: allies gain M temporary HP OR enemies make DEX save for S affinity damage, half on success. No immediate second Renewal healing pulse, no repeat from moving the totem.

source.originalText: Totem Pulse: Totems create an immediate area effect when placed (level 6).

card.name: Spirit Saturation
card.effect: Waive its 2 RP placement cost once. Still use Action, concentration, capacity and any added costs. Cannot create a healing totem or be cached/refunded to generate more free casts.

source.originalText: Spirit Saturation: Gain one free totem cast per combat (level 9).

card.name: Elemental Channeling
card.effect: Embody affinity: gain+10 ft Speed and once/turn add 1d4 affinity damage to a weapon hit. Fire/cold/lightning/bludgeoning by affinity. This concentration replaces your totem burden, so it is a tactical alternative.

source.originalText: Elemental Channeling: Temporarily embody your chosen element, gaining related benefits.

card.name: Ancestral Guardian
card.effect: A guardian prevents S d8+M damage, minimum 0. It then vanishes and creates no companion action, corpse or refund. Cannot prevent sacrifice/trauma or redirect prevented damage into another trigger.

source.originalText: Ancestral Guardian: Summon a protective spirit that intercepts damage meant for you.

card.name: Elemental Surge
card.effect: Choose one: aura radius+5 ft OR numerical flat benefit improves by 1. Renewal instead adds M HP to its next paid pulse, once, without adding a pulse. Same-name/stat stacking rules remain.

source.originalText: Elemental Surge: Enhance a totem's effect for one round.

card.name: Echo Totem
card.rangeAndTarget: Adjacent empty space within 5 ft of newly placed totem
card.effect: Create a weak echo anchor of that totem. It counts toward capacity; if no space in capacity, cannot create it. Its radius 10 ft and numerical bonuses/healing are half, rounded down. Shared concentration/upkeep and same-name nonstacking prevent double healing.

source.originalText: Echo Totem: Automatically cast a second, weaker totem when placing your primary totem.

card.name: Elemental Harmony
card.effect: Add class level to its maximum/current HP on creation and 1 turn duration, maximum 4 turns for class summons. Cannot extend once/day Chorus beyond 4 turns or restore an existing creature's lost HP.

source.originalText: Elemental Harmony: Your elemental summons gain increased duration and health.

card.name: Spiritual Resonance
card.rangeAndTarget: Two of your active totems within 10 ft of one another
card.effect: Their aura radii increase 5 ft. No extra targets or extra pulses and overlapping same-name benefits do not stack. One totem and its echo still use normal capacity.

source.originalText: Spiritual Resonance: Totems affect a larger area when placed near each other.

card.name: Summon Ice Wisp
card.rangeAndTarget: One spirit in empty space within 30 ft
card.effect: Summon standard Ice Wisp with fly 30 ft. Commanded attack deals cold; on hit target STR save or Speed 0 until end its next turn. No whole-turn freezing, bonus independent spells or multiple companion attacks.

source.originalText: Summon Ice Wisp: Call forth a spirit of frost that can snare and freeze enemies.

card.name: Summon Airling
card.effect: Summon standard Airling with fly 40 ft. Commanded attack deals lightning; on hit target CON save or loses Reactions until end its next turn. Failure by 10 also Stunned, subject to the shared hard-denial guard across all the Shaman’s features. Companion Stun counts as the Shaman’s denial; if the target already suffered that denial this encounter, only damage and Reaction loss resolve. One shared companion command.

source.originalText: Summon Airling: Conjure an air elemental that stuns enemies and deals lightning damage.

card.name: Summon Cinderflame
card.effect: Summon standard Cinderflame. Commanded hit deals fire plus Burn 1d4 next target turn. On destruction only (not dismissal), up to 3 enemies within 5 ft make DEX save for S d4 fire, half. Explosion creates no further death/resource triggers.

source.originalText: Summon Cinderflame: Create a fire spirit that applies burning damage over time and explodes on death.

card.name: Summon Stonekin
card.effect: Summon standard Stonekin. Command chooses bludgeoning attack with STR save or Prone on hit, OR gives up to 3 adjacent allies reduction 2 until start next turn. No simultaneous attack and protection command.

source.originalText: Summon Stonekin: Manifest an earth elemental that can root enemies and grant damage reduction to allies.

card.name: Elemental Chorus
card.rangeAndTarget: Four spirits in 10 ft-radius zone within 30 ft
card.effect: Summon a single Chorus package: four visible spirits share HP 4 L, AC 12+PB, immobile. Bonus Action command pulses up to 3 enemies: DEX save S d6 chosen affinity damage half; one failed target Speed-10 ft until end next turn. Four spirits do not make four separate attacks.

source.originalText: Elemental Chorus: Ultimate ability that summons all four elemental types around a zone for massive combined effect.

card.name: Divining Totem
card.rangeAndTarget: One divining totem within 30 ft; observed enemy in aura
card.effect: Each own-turn start choose one visible enemy in 15 ft aura. First ally attack against it before your next turn gains+1 to hit; first attack it makes has-1. Predicts immediate intent, not guaranteed future actions; totem has ordinary object stats.

source.originalText: Divining Totem: Place a special totem that reveals enemy actions before they occur (one target per round).

card.name: Omen Loop
card.cost: Normal RP+2 RP; fresh flask if required; 1 long-rest use
card.rangeAndTarget: Your own qualifying effect used within previous 2 turns
card.effect: Repeat one non-Finale, non-resource-restoring class flask/totem effect with normal targets and full costs. It replaces the current Action; cannot repeat another repeat, regain per-rest uses or exceed totem capacity. If effect required a flask, consume one now.

source.originalText: Omen Loop: Ultimate ability that repeats a spell, flask, or totem cast from two turns ago (once per encounter).

card.name: Hagraven Form
card.effect: Become Hagraven: retain player control/mental stats, light-armor use and ordinary movement; claws are finesse 1d6 slashing, darkvision 60 ft and poison resistance. Lose ordinary Shaman spellcasting/advanced magical flasks; retain RP for printed techniques and totems. No free flight or hidden monster stat block.

source.originalText: Hagraven Form: Your body transforms into a twisted, avian-humanoid hybrid with natural weapons and resistances.

card.name: Blood Feast
card.rangeAndTarget: Self at start regular turn; hostile bleeding creature within 10 ft
card.effect: Pay 1 RP to regain M HP. Bleeding allies, summons or staged captives cannot qualify. No healing while Downed; secondary heal creates no damage/resource triggers.

source.originalText: Blood Feast: Heal when enemies near you are bleeding.

card.name: Blight Totem
card.rangeAndTarget: Totem within 30 ft; 15 ft aura affecting all creatures
card.effect: HP healing received inside aura is halved, rounding down, including allies and you. Nonstacking with another healing reduction; temporary HP unaffected. This totem has standard object stats and grants no free damage/healing.

source.originalText: Blight Totem: Place a corrupted totem that reduces all healing in its area by 50%.

card.name: Elder Spirit Accord — new Hero capstone
card.effect: When starting Elemental Chorus, Omen Loop or Bloodroot Trail, reduce its RP cost by 3, minimum 1, and add M to one damage/healing roll from that use. You must know that ability and still spend its own limited use. If you do not know it, instead reduce one known Hero technique's RP cost by 3, minimum 1. No extra duration, flask, totem, command or repeated cast.

classRecords.text: At 5 automatically gain Palisade Deployment. Spend one carried barricade kit and an Action to erect a 2-by 1-tile wall in contiguous unoccupied ground within 5 ft. Height 5 ft, AC 12, HP 5+CON modifier minimum 1, immunity psychic/poison; blocks movement and line of sight across its full height but can be climbed using 10 ft movement. One kit/use per encounter, two at 13; a long rest with carpentry tools replenishes 2 kits (carried maximum 2, reusable parts have no resale value). Material is required; no conjuring. At most one intact wall, two at 13. Old wall must be dismantled in 1 minute before replacement beyond cap. Once per encounter an Action repairs a wall for M HP using spare parts; destruction does not refresh uses.

card.name: Quick Deploy
card.effect: Place low cover from carried field supplies: AC 12, HP 5, grants half cover and is difficult terrain. It is not a full palisade and does not grant its bonuses. One at a time; no transferable saleable material.

source.originalText: Quick Deploy: Set up a temporary barricade that provides partial cover.

card.name: Rally Point
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies within 15 ft who hear you
card.effect: Each gains M temporary HP and+1 on the next saving throw before duration ends. Temporary HP follows strongest-only rule and is lost at encounter end.

source.originalText: Rally Point: Designate a location that grants allies who move there a small defensive bonus.

card.name: Palisade Deployment
card.effect: Automatic engine, not a selected skill. Build the palisade with the exact statistics, kit and repair rules in the class engine. Source minimum 5 retained.

source.originalText: Palisade Deployment: Deploy a 2x1 barrier that blocks movement and line of sight (level 5).

card.name: Rallying Cry
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies within 30 ft who hear you
card.duration: Instant; temp HP to encounter end
card.effect: End Frightened on each and grant S+M temporary HP. Cannot revive, heal real HP or repeatedly refresh from imitation/copies.

source.originalText: Rallying Cry: Remove fear effects from nearby allies and grant temporary hit points.

card.name: Palisade Synergy
card.rangeAndTarget: Your ranged weapon attack while adjacent to palisade
card.effect: Add S damage. Does not apply to every shot, area save or turret hit, and requires an intact wall you deployed.

source.originalText: Palisade Synergy: Your attacks deal additional damage to enemies adjacent to your palisades.

card.name: Turret Deployment
card.rangeAndTarget: Up to 2 empty squares within 10 ft
card.effect: Deploy 2 turrets, each AC 12+PB and HP 2 L, immobile, range 60 ft. On your Bonus Action command ONE turret to attack using PB+DEX for 1d6+M piercing. Both share that single command/attack budget with other companions; no autonomous shots. Reclaimed after use, no resale.

source.originalText: Turret Deployment: Deploy up to 2 automated turrets that last 3 rounds, firing for 1d6+WIS damage and applying Snare or Disrupt effects.

card.name: Bubble of Discipline
card.duration: Until start of your second next turn
card.effect: Deploy dense layered cover. Up to 3 allies inside gain+2 AC against spell attacks and advantage on DEX saves against spells from outside. Once total, Reaction reduce spell damage to one protected ally by 2 S+M. Does not negate a spell, block internal casting or protect each ally independently.

source.originalText: Bubble of Discipline: Create a 3x3 area effect that blocks 1 spell per ally for 2 rounds (once per rest).

card.name: Final Command
card.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 3 willing allies within 30 ft who hear you
card.effect: New Hero capstone. Allies may each move 10 ft without opportunity attacks and gain S+M temporary HP. You refresh one expended short-rest Soldier card, excluding Final Command and long-rest features. A refreshed card still costs its activation and ammunition; no extra turn or recursive resets.

classRecords.text: Dexterity governs weapons and class DC/M. Choose Intelligence or Wisdom for noncombat class tool/sense checks at 1. Hit Die d8; light armor, daggers, shortswords, thrown weapons and hand crossbows; thieves tools and poison kit. Sneak Attack is automatic at 1: once on your regular turn, add ceil(class level/2)d6 to one finesse/ranged weapon hit if you had advantage, an active ally threatens target within 5 ft, or target is suffering your Bleed/Poisoned/Crippled. Disadvantage prevents Sneak Attack even if canceled into a straight roll. A feature can explicitly grant Sneak Attack on a different qualifying hit but never more than once/regular turn. Copies, poison ticks and companions cannot Sneak Attack.

card.name: Disable Device
card.frequency: At will; retries need changed approach
card.effect: Make DEX+PB against its stated disarm DC; unknown DC defaults 15 for ordinary trap, 20 complex. Success disarms one accessible mechanism, failure by 5 triggers it. Does not automatically dispel magic.

source.originalText: Disable Device: Disarm non-magical traps, pressure plates, or poison glyphs.

card.name: Arcane Theft
card.rangeAndTarget: One enemy within 30 ft with observed spell buff
card.effect: Target WIS save. Failure suppress one eligible temporary rank 1–3 buff for duration and gain only its printed AC bonus (max 2), Speed bonus(max 10 ft), or resistance to one damage type; choose before save. Does not copy actions, spells, resources, summons or capstones. Magical technique 1 D.

source.originalText: Arcane Theft: Steal a beneficial spell effect from a target and apply it to yourself.

classRecords.text: Intelligence governs class DC/M, device attacks use PB+INT; Dexterity governs personal ranged weapons. Hit Die d8, light armor, shortbows/crossbows/simple weapons, tinkers tools and alchemist supplies. Technology is fictional equipment. Ordinary Tinker spells use RP/Dissonance; mundane bombs/devices with printed RP fuel costs are class techniques and do not separately count as spell casts.

At 1 automatically own one Anacite Drone: AC 13+INT modifier, HP 5+INT modifier+class level (minimum 1), flight 30 ft, ranged bolt 60 ft attack PB+INT for 1d6 piercing. Bonus Action commands one move and one attack or named module action; otherwise it Dodges and may follow you. On bolt hit roll d4; on 4 target CON save or cannot take Reactions through end next turn (Shock, no automatic Stun). All drones/turrets/scraplings share ONE damaging action per Bonus Action command per regular turn unless a card explicitly supplies a priced extra attack. No autonomous barrage. Drone is a construct, not immune to all conditions; poison/psychic immunity, no charm. Carry/retract it in 1 minute; no pocket extra world or passenger flight.

A destroyed drone remains 0 HP until repaired for 1 RP and 10 minutes with tools to half HP, once/short rest, or rebuilt during long rest to full. Ordinary repairing does not recharge devices, grant organic healing or trigger destruction bonuses. At 13 Dual Drone Protocols automatically chooses on each long rest either 2 basic drones each with one module, or one drone with 2 distinct modules. Still one command budget. Never more than 2 drones.

At 5 automatically gain one module slot; change module during long rest. Offensive: Burn Injector first bolt hit/turn causes 1d4 fire next 2 target turns; Poison Vents d4=4 on hit CON save or-1 attack rolls until end next turn; Concussive Bolt d4=4 on hit CON save or Stunned until end next turn, once/target/encounter shared denial guard and 1/short-rest successful Stun. Defensive: Target Taunter command action once/encounter WIS save one foe 30 ft or disadvantage attacking others until end next turn; Energy Shield command gives adjacent ally+2 AC until start next turn; Smoke Cloud command once/encounter creates 5 ft radius opaque smoke centered drone until start next turn. Support: Ammo Dispenser adjacent allies first ranged hit/turn+1 damage; Target Scanner command mark 1 visible foe 60 ft first ally attack before start next turn+1 hit; Tether Grappler command once/encounter pulls 1 willing ally 15 ft within 30 ft without opportunity attacks along open route.

Advanced bomb profiles replace basic rider: Thermobaric fire pushes 5 ft on failed STR save after damage; Cryo cold on failed DEX also Speed 0 until end next turn and d2=2 ignores 1 flat DR against this bomb; Shock lightning CON instead DEX, failure prevents verbal spellcasting until end next turn (construct instead loses Reactions), shared hard-denial guard; Glue no damage, 15 ft square difficult terrain 3 rounds and entering/starting DEX save or Speed-15 ft until end turn, once per creature/round. Overload Core destroys one commanded drone within 30 ft as part Action bomb, DEX save 2d6 lightning and no Reactions until end next turn on failure, half damage on success. Consumes stock/allowance; no further destruction proc.

Deployable slots start 1 at 6, 2 at 13, 3 at 17, separate from drone cap. Deploy Action 2 RP within 15 ft, fixed ground, AC 12+PB HP 2 L, duration 3 rounds, concentration not required; destroyed do not refund fuel. All share command budget. Sentry and Net require their cards. Additional engine profiles unlocked 6: Rocket Tower commanded attack 60 ft target DEX save S d6 fire/half success to up to 2 creatures within 5 ft, maximum 3 shots; Decoy Dummy one foe 30 ft WIS save when deployed or disadvantage on next attack against others, destruction S fire to one adjacent enemy no chain; Blast Wall 10-by 5 ft blocks LOS and movement, climb cost 10 ft. Net Trap one enemy entry STR save or Restrained, end turn repeat/Action escape DC, 3 round max then ends. One only fires when commanded except nonattack trap/decoy trigger; command budget limits damaging triggers too.

Base 1–2, Mechanist Arch 3–9, then Artificer/Techsmith/Warmachine Hero 10–20. Upgrade Slot 5 is automatic; Sentry and Net minimum 6, Remote Detonation 9. There is no source automatic Arch capstone. Mech Overdrive 20 is automatic: once/long rest when deploying choose one device whose duration becomes encounter end (maximum 1 minute), still command dependent, slot limited and destructible. No infinite pulses: healing effects keep original pulse cap and all per-use costs remain. Protected magic interface: once per short rest, as a Bonus Action route up to 2 current Dissonance into one of your active devices within 30 ft. Reduce Dissonance by that amount; the device is disabled and cannot move, attack, emit an aura or trigger effects until repaired or your next completed short rest. Its duration keeps ticking. Repair with an Action and 1 RP using Field Repair, or with 10 minutes and 1 RP using tinkers tools. No RP is created and no Refrain counter resets.

card.name: Mechanical Aptitude
card.effect: Advantage on checks to understand, repair or disable mechanisms. Requires appropriate access and tools; no automatic control of enemy constructs.

source.originalText: Mechanical Aptitude: Gain advantage on checks to understand, repair, or disable mechanical devices.

card.name: Explosive Handling
card.effect: Throw a known prepared bomb as Bonus Action instead of Action. Removes ordinary accidental misfire, not Warmachine risk or enemy defenses. Cannot command a device with the same Bonus Action.

source.originalText: Explosive Handling: Throw bombs as a bonus action without risk of misfire.

card.name: Quick Fingers
card.effect: Open unlocked latch, operate simple switch or retrieve a carried gadget. Does not activate damaging/healing devices, disarm a trap, reload every weapon or add another Bonus Action.

source.originalText: Quick Fingers: Perform device activation and manipulation actions with increased speed.

card.name: Deploy Anacite Drone
card.effect: Drone is automatic class engine. Selecting this card instead upgrades deployment to Bonus Action and permits 5 ft free initial placement. No free attacks, repair or extra drone.

source.originalText: Deploy Anacite Drone: Summon a mechanical companion that attacks with ranged bolts (1d6 damage + 25% chance to shock).

card.name: Field Repair
card.effect: Restore S d8+M HP, up to maximum, to functional damaged machine. Cannot revive destroyed objects, heal organic allies, reset duration or recharge limited uses. If the target is disabled by the Tinker’s protected Dissonance-routing feature, Field Repair also clears that disabled state. It does not reset duration, recharge, ammunition or per-rest uses.

source.originalText: Field Repair: Quickly fix a damaged mechanical device or construct.

card.name: Analyze Weakness
card.effect: Identify one visibly demonstrated damage resistance. Your next bomb/device damage against it ignores 2 flat DR, not resistance/immunity. No invented weakness or automatic secret knowledge.

source.originalText: Analyze Weakness: Study a target to identify vulnerabilities to specific damage types.

card.name: Jury-rig
card.effect: Choose+1 first attack roll/turn or+5 ft device movement. One modification per item, no stack. Does not change weapon category, spell function, summon limit or command budget.

source.originalText: Jury-rig: Temporarily modify a device or weapon to perform a different function.

card.name: Enhanced Drone Control
card.effect: Gain+1 attack roll and can follow simple move/dodge commands while within 120 ft. Attacks still require your Bonus Action and line of effect; no independent turn.

source.originalText: Enhanced Drone Control: Your Anacite Drone gains improved targeting and responsiveness.

card.name: Pet Upgrade Slot
card.effect: Choose one of 9 bounded modules in engine. This automatic unlock is not a selected skill. At 13 use Dual Drone Protocols, still shared command budget.

source.originalText: Pet Upgrade Slot: Modify your drone with an Offensive, Defensive, or Support module (level 5).

card.name: Deployable Expertise
card.effect: Gain M maximum/initial HP and+1 AC. Does not heal existing damage when moved or grant additional slots. Drones excluded unless another card says otherwise.

source.originalText: Deployable Expertise: Your deployed devices have increased durability and effectiveness.

card.name: Remote Detonation
card.rangeAndTarget: Device within 60 ft, 10 ft radius up to 3 creatures
card.effect: Destroy your device; DEX save 2 S d6 force, half success. Failed save also no Reactions until end next turn. Cannot trigger Volatile Components/Scrap Reaper or another destruction/copy chain; no resource refund.

source.originalText: Remote Detonation: Detonate your devices remotely for area effect damage or stunning (level 9).

card.name: Deploy Sentry Turret
card.effect: Deploy Sentry engine profile: commanded attack range 25 ft PB+INT for 1d6 piercing. No auto fire, extra Bonus Action or shared budget exception. Durability AC 12+PB HP 2 L before upgrades.

source.originalText: Deploy Sentry Turret: Place an automated turret that fires at enemies (level 6).

card.name: Deploy Net Trap
card.effect: Deploy visible Net Trap. First enemy entry STR save or Restrained, repeat end turn or Action escape against DC. Target Huge+instead speed-10 ft. No damage or continued rearming; ends after one creature escapes.

source.originalText: Deploy Net Trap: Set a trap that roots enemies who trigger it (level 6).

card.name: Overcharge
card.effect: Next damaging activation adds S d6 to one target. One pending overcharge, no stacking, does not command device or grant attack. If device expires first cost lost.

source.originalText: Overcharge: Temporarily boost the effectiveness of one of your devices.

card.name: Recalibrate
card.rangeAndTarget: One drone; one visible enemy 60 ft
card.effect: Drone's next attack against chosen enemy has advantage. Still needs separate command; no automatic shot, enemy type wide permanent buff or crit conversion.

source.originalText: Recalibrate: Adjust your drone's targeting parameters to focus on a specific enemy type.

card.name: Emergency Protocols
card.rangeAndTarget: Drone within 10 ft when attack hits you
card.effect: Drone intercepts: reduce damage to you by S+M and takes same amount unmitigated. It must be active/conscious. Does not redirect again or trigger retaliation loops.

source.originalText: Emergency Protocols: Your drone automatically intercepts an attack meant for you once per encounter.

card.name: Protective Programming
card.rangeAndTarget: Drone adjacent to ally hit by attack
card.effect: Drone grants ally S+M temporary HP before hit resolves. No heal or reversal of hit; max one protected ally, normal temporary HP nonstacking.

source.originalText: Protective Programming: Your drone prioritizes defending vulnerable allies.

card.name: Efficient Power Cells
card.effect: A 3 round device lasts 4 rounds (50%rounded down). Healing pulse count unchanged, no extra ammunition or free commands. Does not extend spell concentration.

source.originalText: Efficient Power Cells: Your devices last 50% longer before needing recharging.

card.name: Nano-Aegis Drone
card.effect: Replace bolts with support mode. Each Bonus Action command pay 1 RP choose one ally 30 ft to heal S d6+M or grant 2 S+Mtemp HP. Maximum 3 pulses; organic healing explicit exception, no attack during mode.

source.originalText: Nano-Aegis Drone: Replace your combat drone with a healing/shield drone that protects allies.

card.name: Repair Pulse
card.duration: Instant; AC until start next turn
card.effect: Restore each half its maximum HP rounded down and+1 AC. Functional devices only; no construct resurrection, organic HP, resource or use resets.

source.originalText: Repair Pulse: Heal all drones, turrets, and party deployables for 50% HP and grant +1 AC to nearby allies.

card.name: Restoration Field
card.cost: 3 RP start; 1 RP maintenance; one slot
card.effect: Concentration. Initial and paid Bonus Action pulse heals up to 3 living allies/devices S d6 HP. Devices must not be destroyed. Same creature once/round, no extra autonomous healing or longer Efficient Cells.

source.originalText: Restoration Field: Create an area that gradually repairs mechanical devices and heals organic allies.

card.name: Overload Suppression
card.effect: CON save or fails its next Reaction and has disadvantage on attacks. On failure by 5 also Stunned, shared hard-denial guard. No automatic permanent deactivation, hacking allegiance or ignoring boss immunity.

source.originalText: Overload Suppression: Temporarily disable enemy mechanical devices or constructs.

card.name: Automated Field Kit
card.effect: Bomb stock cap/refill+1; encounter allowance unchanged. Reduce deployable card recharge by 1 minimum 1, on setting counter only. Never refresh rest uses or trigger repeated counter reductions.

source.originalText: Automated Field Kit: Carry an extra bomb and reduce deployable cooldowns by 1 round.

card.name: Enhanced Targeting
card.effect: Gain+1 to hit. Does not stack with Enhanced Drone Control if profile ever counts both, and does not impose save penalties.

source.originalText: Enhanced Targeting: Your turrets gain +1 to hit.

card.name: Efficient Recycling
card.effect: Recover 1 RP spent on deploying it, never more than its actual paid cost. Deliberate sacrifice or copy does not qualify. Consume usable debris; no repeated salvage from same object.

source.originalText: Efficient Recycling: Recover components from destroyed devices to create new ones.

card.name: Technical Mastery
card.effect: After damage rolld 10; on 10 you may pay 1 RP to add half its unmodified damage dice total rounded down to one target. No second activation, commands, procs, resources or healing duplication.

source.originalText: Technical Mastery: Your devices have a 10% chance to function twice when activated.

card.name: Advanced Turret Bay
card.rangeAndTarget: Two empty ground spaces within 15 ft
card.effect: Requires 2 available slots (normally 13); if only one, deploy one for 2 RP. Sniper command attack 90 ft S d6 piercing; Burst command DEX save S d4 piercing to 2 targets within 5 ftat 30 ft. One commanded turret per Bonus Action, not both automatically.

source.originalText: Advanced Turret Bay: Deploy two turrets simultaneously in either Sniper or Burst mode.

card.name: Gadget Sync Protocol
card.rangeAndTarget: One turret within 60 ft after your bomb throw
card.effect: Turret makes one ordinary shot at surviving bomb target. Replaces its normal commanded damaging action for that turn; cannot combine with another device attack from Bonus Action. No chains or additional bombs.

source.originalText: Gadget Sync Protocol: When you throw a bomb, one turret may fire instantly at the same target.

card.name: Snap Rebuild
card.effect: Restore half its maximum HP. Uses original slot and original expiry; expired devices ineligible. Does not reset limited uses, modules, Overdrive, destruction triggers or bomb stock.

source.originalText: Snap Rebuild: Once per encounter, instantly redeploy any destroyed turret or pet with 50% HP.

card.name: Reconfiguration
card.effect: Change between known nonhealing profiles using same HP fraction, slot, expiry and spent uses. Cannot turn a 1 slot device into two, refill ammo, reset trap, create fresh death trigger or morph drone into free bomb.

source.originalText: Reconfiguration: Transform one deployed device into another type.

card.name: Malfunction Field
card.rangeAndTarget: Enemy within 5 ft of your device
card.effect: First spell attack by one enemy has disadvantage. Multiple devices do not multiply effect; area/spell-saves unchanged. Does not create antimagic zone.

source.originalText: Malfunction Field: Enemies near your devices must roll twice on spell attacks and take the lower result.

card.name: Volatile Components
card.rangeAndTarget: One device destroyed by enemy; one enemy within 5 ft
card.effect: Deal S fire to that enemy. Deliberate sacrifices, copied objects, friendly damage and secondary explosions cannot trigger. No other procs/resources from damage.

source.originalText: Volatile Components: Your devices explode when destroyed, damaging nearby enemies.

card.name: Scrap Salvage
card.rangeAndTarget: Empty space within 5 ft of debris
card.effect: Create one Scrapling AC 12 HP L Speed 20 ft, commanded melee attack PB+INT for 1d6 bludgeoning. Counts as deployable slot/shared command. Consumed debris cannot be salvaged again; cannot spawn its own replacement.

source.originalText: Scrap Salvage: Create temporary minions from destroyed devices.

card.name: Boomcore Drone
card.effect: Commanded bolts add 1d6 fire and on hit STR save or push 5 ft. Still one command and normal attack budget; no free activation attack or unlimited stacking.

source.originalText: Boomcore Drone: Upgrade your drone to use blast bolts that deal damage and knockback.

card.name: Scrap Reaper
card.effect: Create one Scrapling Speed 30, AC 12 HP L; next Bonus Action command moves and detonates within 5 ft one enemy for 2 S d6 fire DEX half. Uses one command budget and ends. No chain from deliberate sacrifice or its own death.

source.originalText: Scrap Reaper: When a turret or drone dies, summon a Scrapling that chases and explodes on enemies.

card.name: Volatile Injection
card.effect: Must have strictly more HP than cost. Its next damaging activation adds S d6 to one target; cannot combine with Overcharge, damage cannot be refunded by same activation. No resources gained from self damage.

source.originalText: Volatile Injection: Temporarily boost a device's power at the cost of stability.

card.name: Catastrophic Overload
card.rangeAndTarget: 10 ft radius about device within 60 ft
card.effect: All creatures including allies DEX save, 3 S d6 fire plus 3 S d6 force on failure, half success. No critical hit, additional destruction proc, salvage, automatic stun or copied damage. Device ends before blast; no Safety exclusion.

source.originalText: Catastrophic Overload: Sacrifice a device for a massive explosion that damages all nearby creatures.

card.name: Mech Overdrive
card.cost: 1 long-rest use plus original deployment cost
card.rangeAndTarget: One of your newly deployed devices
card.effect: Source-derived level 20 feature: extend device duration only. It still occupies its slot, requires normal commands and payments, and is destructible. Healing devices keep maximum 3 pulses; bombs, spent uses and expended charges never refill. Does not create permanent equipment.

source.originalText: You begin with one deployable slot and gain additional slots as you level up. At level 20, you gain Mech Overdrive, allowing one device to become permanent for the duration of a battle.

classRecords.text: BT CAP AND RESET. Default BT cap is 3. Stack Overflow raises it to 4. BT is not automatically spent; only features explicitly saying spend reduce it. Encounter end resets BT and Brutality Progress to 0. BT cannot be generated from friendly attacks, summoned sacrificial creatures, unattended objects, staged sparring or enemies that do not meaningfully threaten the party.

HEALING AND REGENERATION. Warrior healing cannot exceed maximum HP, restore the dead or remove Wounds unless a card explicitly says otherwise. Regeneration and repeated healing effects operate only during real encounters unless their card explicitly permits downtime healing. No corpse, summoned creature, trivial enemy or friendly target can be used to create infinite healing, serum doses or BT.

card.name: Mutation Surge
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.effect: Mutation Surge. Enhance one active mutation. If it grants AC, DR, attack, save or flat damage, increase one such bonus by 1; if it grants movement or reach, increase it by 5 feet; if it deals mutation damage, add 1d4 to one damage event. A mutation with none of those numeric effects instead grants S temporary HP. The enhancement never changes immunity, target count or duration.

source.originalText: Mutation Surge: Temporarily enhance an active mutation, increasing its effects for 1 round but adding strain to your body.

card.name: Brutality Momentum
card.effect: Brutality Momentum. When you personally reduce a creature marked Vulnerable by Brutality Sense to 0 HP with a melee attack, set Brutal Strike's positive round-recharge counter to 0 if it has not already been reset or shortened this round. This restores no Action and cannot refresh a per-rest use. Trivial, summoned or friendly creatures cannot trigger it.

source.originalText: Brutality Momentum: Killing a marked vulnerable target instantly readies your next Brutal Strike.

card.name: Aegis Incarnate
card.effect: Final Form – Aegis Incarnate. For 3 rounds you cannot be forcibly moved or knocked Prone. Whenever an ally within 15 feet takes damage, automatically redirect half that damage rounded down to yourself after the ally's resistance but before its temporary HP; the ally takes the remainder. Redirected damage keeps its type, cannot be reduced again or generate BT, and cannot be redirected again. If taking the redirected damage would kill you outright, the redirection still occurs. This grants no extra Reaction requirement and does not stack with Guardian Tissue on the same damage event.

source.originalText: Final Form – Aegis Incarnate: Transform into a living shield for 3 rounds, becoming immovable and redirecting 50% of all damage dealt to allies within 15 feet to yourself.

card.name: Bone Hardened
card.effect: While you are not Staggered, reduce physical weapon damage you take by 1 after resistance and before temporary HP.

source.originalText: | 6 | Bone Hardened: DR +1 while not staggered |

card.name: Hemophage Core
card.effect: When you personally reduce a meaningful hostile creature to 0 HP with a melee attack, regain 2d6 HP. Summoned, trivial, friendly or repeatedly revived creatures cannot trigger this healing. Each HP actually restored spends 1 Mutation Recovery Reserve; heal no more than remaining reserve.

source.originalText: Hemophage Core (heal on kill; absorb 2d6 HP)

classRecords.text: ABJURATION, provisional completion for the omitted eighth row: once per round after you cast an Abjuration spell, gain temporary HP equal to PB until the start of your next regular turn. CONJURATION: creatures summoned by your Wizard spells gain +1 maximum HP per Wizard level. DIVINATION: once per long rest reroll one failed saving throw and use the new result. ENCHANTMENT: when a creature fails its initial save against one of your Enchantment spells, a printed control duration of at least 1 round may last one additional round, but every normally allowed repeat save still occurs. EVOCATION: when casting an area Evocation spell, exclude one creature from its initial damaging area; that creature automatically succeeds and takes no damage if success normally halves damage. ILLUSION: gain +2 on concentration saves made to maintain Illusion spells. NECROMANCY: once per turn during a real encounter when a hostile non-summoned creature dies from your Necromancy spell, gain 1 temporary HP; it is not permanent healing. TRANSMUTATION: after casting a Transmutation spell, gain +5 feet Speed until the end of that turn.

SUMMON COMMAND LIMIT. All Wizard-controlled conjured, raised and bound companions share one damaging/control Companion Command per Wizard regular turn. Spend one Bonus Action to command exactly one such creature to move up to its Speed and use one damaging or control action from its stat block. Uncommanded creatures may reposition defensively and take Dodge but cannot deal damage or impose conditions. No summoned or raised creature can create XP, treasure, RP, Dissonance relief, additional corpses or kill-resource farms.

ELITE UNDEAD PETS. Necromancers may bind Boneflayer, Dreadblade and Wraithbound, at most one of each and three elite pets total. They use the same shared Companion Command limit as standard undead. Boneflayer: AC 14, HP 12 + 2 × Wizard level, Speed 30. Bone Shards: range 60, Wizard spell attack, 2d6+S necrotic. Fear Pulse replaces its attack: enemies within 10 feet make Wisdom saves; failure Frightened until end of next turn; recharge 3. Grave Miasma replaces its attack: 10-foot-radius point within 30 feet until start of your next turn; enemies entering or starting there take 1d6 necrotic once; recharge 3.

Flesh Ascendant's bonus applies after the listed base statistics: every undead creature you control gains +2 maximum HP per Wizard level. If at least two of your undead creatures are active, each gains +1 AC and +1 on saving throws. This does not increase the standard-minion or elite-pet caps.

card.name: Arcane Sight
card.effect: Arcane Sight. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, divination, concentration. While active you perceive magical auras within 60 feet and automatically know each visible aura's school or broad magical category. As an Action on a later turn, examine one aura to learn whether it is concentrated, summoned, cursed, warded or linked to another visible magical effect. Total cover blocks sight.

source.originalText: Arcane Sight: See magical auras and effects for a short duration.

card.name: Knowledge Shield
card.rangeAndTarget: Allies directly protected by one of your Abjuration Wizard spells
card.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At most once per ally per round
card.effect: Knowledge Shield. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, protection. When you cast an Abjuration spell that grants AC, temporary HP, resistance or a saving-throw benefit to an ally, that ally also gains +2 on its next saving throw before the start of your next regular turn. Multiple Knowledge Shields do not stack.

source.originalText: Knowledge Shield: When you cast a protective spell, allies gain +2 to saving throws.

card.name: Matrix Sharing
card.cost: 2 RP plus the shared spell's normal RP cost
card.duration: Until end of ally's next regular turn
card.effect: Matrix Sharing. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive-upgrade, matrix. Choose one prepared Wizard spell of rank 3 or lower with an Action casting time. Pay both costs now. The ally may cast that spell once before the end of its next turn without paying RP, using your spell attack and DC. The shared spell cannot summon creatures, create additional Actions, use Overcast, be Shared again or bypass concentration limits. Granting this permission takes your Action; the ally spends its own normal Action to cast. The ally owns concentration and strain for the cast, and it does not update your matrix-family history or grant you cast-trigger resources.

source.originalText: Matrix Sharing: Grant an ally temporary access to one of your prepared spells.

card.name: Spell Absorption
card.rangeAndTarget: One hostile spell that directly targets you
card.effect: Spell Absorption. Tags: hero, spellbinder, wizard-spell, abjuration. Trigger after you become the target of a hostile spell but before it resolves. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell rank. On success that spell has no effect on you, though it resolves normally against other targets, and you gain temporary HP equal to spell rank + M. On failure it resolves normally and the use is spent.

source.originalText: Spell Absorption: Absorb a hostile spell, gaining temporary hit points equal to the spell's level.

card.name: Arcane Fusion
card.cost: Combined normal RP costs of both spells + 2 RP
card.duration: Instantaneous or as individual legal effects
card.effect: Arcane Fusion. Tags: hero, elementalist, fusion, matrix. Choose two DIFFERENT prepared Wizard spells of rank 5 or lower, neither of which summons a creature or grants an additional Action. Pay both full RP costs plus 2 and resolve both spells sequentially as one Action. They may share or have different legal targets. They cannot both require concentration. Each matrix separately updates protected first-cast/Refrain state, but features triggered by 'casting a spell' may trigger only once from the Fusion, chosen by you. Fusion itself cannot be copied, Shared or used inside Dual Cast.

source.originalText: Arcane Fusion: Combine two spells into a single, more powerful effect.

card.name: Flesh Ascendant
card.effect: Flesh Ascendant. Tags: hero, necromancer, passive, undead. Each undead creature you control gains +2 maximum HP per Wizard class level. While at least two of your undead creatures are active, each also gains +1 AC and +1 on saving throws. These bonuses apply after the common standard-minion and elite-pet statistics and do not increase companion caps or command frequency.

source.originalText: Flesh Ascendant: All undead gain +2 HP per Wizard level, if 2+ undead are active, gain +1 AC and Save

card.name: Arcane Leech
card.effect: Arcane Leech. Tags: hero, necromancer, passive. When at least one hostile creature fails a saving throw against one of your Wizard spells, gain temporary HP equal to S+M. Multiple failed targets from the same spell do not multiply the amount. This does not drain actual HP, generate RP or trigger from your companions' abilities.

source.originalText: Arcane Leech: Gain temporary hit points when a creature fails a save against your spells.

card.name: Binding Sigil
card.rangeAndTarget: One creature directly affected by your Wizard spell
card.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
card.frequency: At most one marked creature at a time
card.effect: Binding Sigil. Tags: hero, necromancer, passive, mark. After one creature takes damage from or fails a save against your Wizard spell, you may mark it. Until the end of your next regular turn you have advantage on Wizard spell attacks against that creature. Marking another creature ends the previous mark. Echoes, companions and environmental damage cannot apply it.

source.originalText: Binding Sigil: Mark a creature, giving you advantage on spell attacks against it.

card.name: Corpse Harvest
card.rangeAndTarget: One eligible humanoid corpse within 30 feet
card.duration: Until destroyed, dismissed or your next long rest
card.effect: Corpse Harvest. Tags: hero, necromancer, wizard-spell, undead, summon. Raise the corpse as a Skeleton or Zombie using the common standard-undead statistics; a goblinoid corpse may instead become a Goblin Thrall. The corpse is consumed into that minion state. The creature obeys the shared Bonus Action Companion Command rule. Creating a fourth standard minion requires dismissing one existing standard minion first.

source.originalText: Corpse Harvest: Raise skeletons/goblins/zombies from slain humanoids

card.name: Ghoul Lash
card.rangeAndTarget: One of your standard undead minions with another allied undead within 5 feet
card.effect: Ghoul Lash. Tags: hero, necromancer, undead, command. Use your shared Companion Command on the chosen standard minion. If another undead you control is within 5 feet of it when commanded, it makes TWO copies of its normal damaging attack instead of one. Both attacks are part of the same single shared damaging command and cannot create additional commands, Actions or auto-raise events beyond the common once-per-round Auto-Raise limit.

source.originalText: Ghoul Lash: Minions within 1 tile of each other gain bonus attacks

card.name: Dual Cast
card.cost: Pay the complete RP costs of both spells
card.effect: Source progression line 5188. Choose two DIFFERENT prepared Wizard spells of rank 1 or 2, neither of which summons a creature or grants an additional Action. Cast both sequentially as one Action, paying both RP costs. They cannot both require concentration. Each matrix separately updates first-cast/Refrain history. Features that trigger merely from 'casting a spell' may trigger once for each actual matrix unless that feature itself says once per turn; no trigger may create another Dual Cast or additional full Action.
